$comment: The trained teacher this project builds on. Pinned here because it is the
one artifact in the repository that is not reproducible: 1 h 58 m of GPU
time, and a rerun under a different seed gives different weights. Every
transfer comparison has to be against the same teacher or it measures the
teacher instead of the transfer. tests/test_teacher_policy.py checks this
file against the bytes next to it and against the environment config in
source/, so a swapped or stale teacher fails loudly rather than quietly.
Regenerate with g1/policy/README.md if you really mean to replace it.

provenance.usd: Isaac Lab Nucleus, Robots/Unitree/G1/g1.usd (downloaded, not vendored)

source_checkpoint.note: Lives under the gitignored logs/ tree. Recorded so the untracked original can be identified if it is still on disk.

command_distribution.$comment: The only field of the inherited configuration this project overrides.

verification.$comment: Measured after training, not inferred from the reward curve. g1/scripts/measure_gait.py, 32 envs, 8 s.

what_this_does_not_establish: One seed. No claim about variance across training runs.
One speed. Not a general gait controller.
Simulation only. No hardware and no measured actuator model.
Nothing about transfer. A teacher that walks is the input to the question, not an answer.
